style: Original flat graphic emblem for a fictional authoritarian bureaucratic world government in a retro pixel-art game, a decal source. Severe, orderly, institutional and unmistakably authoritarian: heavy symmetrical geometry like an official state seal or rubber stamp. Bold simple shapes with thick clean edges, flat solid colours only: near-black #1E1E22, deep Union red #8C1A1E and bone #E8E2D6. No gradients, no shading, no texture, readable when reduced to 64 pixels
view: Straight-on flat front view, one emblem centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame, perfectly mirror-symmetrical left to right
